summary: Comprehensive plan to fix ghost audio/video playback when switching or failing sources, restore OlaMovies playback via parallel shortener + TMDB/Nuvio/VidSrc racing, auto-skip dead Vega/Nuvio/VidSrc/Decryptor sources while keeping all sources visible, cut APK and GitHub ZIP size by building arm64-v8a only with compressed DEX/JNI libraries (keeping yt-dlp), and reduce app startup time from 10+ seconds to under 2 seconds.
